requirements.blockedBy: No GPU in build environment or Railway deployment; training notebooks + integration record prepared for Colab/Kaggle execution

requirements.title: Godot investigation and decision
requirements.behaviour: Godot 4.7.2 (MIT): auxiliary headless test harness only; Unreal remains primary world runtime
